# ESLint 10 migration, 2026-11-23

The owner requested ESLint 10 and supported lint dependencies. eslint-plugin-react
7.37.5 supports ESLint only through 9; its next tag (7.8.0-rc.0) supports only
3/4. Replaced it with @eslint-react/eslint-plugin 5.30.6, whose published README
requires ESLint 10. Added its recommended-typescript preset plus explicit DOM
property/target and duplicate-key checks. Kept eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1
and all its recommended checks. This is a plugin migration, not identical rule
names/coverage; TypeScript still checks TSX props and types. No peer bypass,
force, overrides, rule-disable additions or relaxed CI checks.

The stricter recommended rules found list index keys and redundant initial
assignments. Lists now use API topic/target IDs; declarations retain both
registry lookup and embedded fallback branches. Rendering and layout unchanged.

Duplicate check: current main and recent/open PRs inspected, including previous
ESLint-9 hold PR #24; no competing ESLint-10 migration. Consumer trace: activity
preview list, detail topic/target lists, modal labels, registry/fallback lookup,
Hooks and TSX lint config. Failing-first list reorder test catches the old
index-key implementation. Linter regression tests reject missing keys, bad DOM
properties, conditional Hooks and missing effect dependencies.

Validation: clean npm ci, zero-warning lint, nine Vitest cases, and TS/Vite
production build pass locally. Native Tauri build not run. No UI layout/style
changes, no DMG and no merge. Independent review and CI pending.

Evidence: npm view eslint-plugin-react dist-tags peerDependencies; npm view
eslint-plugin-react@next version peerDependencies; npm view
@eslint-react/eslint-plugin version peerDependencies readme.
